# ARCADEX

> Midnight Editorial Cognitive Suite & Arcade by Ishant.

ARCADEX is a bespoke, lag-free cognitive gaming suite blending high-end fashion editorial aesthetics with pure mathematical rigor. It features 13 complete protocols, 100 progressive levels per game, 22 anime masters, and real-time telemetry.

## Key Protocols
- Snake (Neural Reflex)
- Tetris (Spatial Matrix)
- 2048 (Exponential Synthesis)
- Anime Sliding Puzzle (22 Anime Masters)
- Sudoku (Numerical Deductions)
- Wordle (Lexical Matrix with 100 levels)
- Memory Match (Synaptic Recall)
- Simon (Acoustic Sequence)
- Chimp Test (Working Memory)
- Corsi Blocks (Visuospatial Span)
- Connect4 (Minimax Adversarial Logic)
- 15-Slide Puzzle (Permutation Logic)
- Arrow Escape (Grid Directional Protocol)
